title: Floor, roof and wall assemblies.
officialText:
The test samples for determining the cohesive/adhesive bond strength of the
sprayed fire-resistant materials shall be selected from each floor, roof and wall assembly at the rate of not less than one sample
for every 2,500 square feet (232 m2) or part thereof of the sprayed area in each story.
